overview: Explore top accredited institutions, tuition costs, eligibility, and visa procedures in Sweden for Chemical Engineering (PG) in Sweden.

universities.name: \. KTH Royal Institute of Technology
universities.location: \. KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Sweden
universities.desc: KTH offers an **MSc in Chemical Engineering for Energy and Environment**, taught in English. The programme focuses on industrial process design, sustainable energy, emissions reduction and circular resource flows. It is a two-year programme leading to a Master of Science degree. **![][image1]**

universities.name: \. Chalmers University of Technology
universities.desc: Chalmers offers **Innovative and Sustainable Chemical Engineering**, a two-year master's programme taught in English. The programme explores efficient chemical processes, sustainable production, recycling, renewable fuels and industrial resource management. **Location:** Gothenburg, Sweden **![][image2]**

universities.name: \. Lund University
universities.desc: Students can explore related postgraduate opportunities in chemical sciences, process-related research, materials and sustainability. Applicants should consult the current programme catalogue to confirm the exact degree title, course structure and entry requirements for their intended intake. **![][image3]** **Important Note:** Among the universities listed above, KTH and Chalmers are the most directly relevant options for chemical engineering. Lund University and Linköping University are alternatives for related specializations and should not automatically be considered providers of a degree specifically titled Chemical Engineering. These institutions are worth exploring when comparing the **Best Universities for Chemical Engineering in Sweden**. Always verify programme availability and degree titles through official university websites.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Chemical Engineering (PG) in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, Indian students with qualifying credentials meeting English language proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL) and academic prerequisites can apply to recognized universities in Sweden.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Chemical Engineering (PG) in Sweden?
items.a: Most master's and international bachelor's degree programmes are taught entirely in English for international students across Swedish universities.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Chemical Engineering (PG) in Sweden?
items.a: Tuition fees for international students generally range between SEK 80,000 and SEK 150,000 per year, depending on the institution and level of study.

items.q: Can international students work while studying in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, non-EU international students holding a valid Swedish residence permit for higher education are permitted to work alongside their studies without a fixed hours limitation during term time.
